items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for bounded reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; missing telemetry is not evidence of safety. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS safety. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates and block security-sensitive releases; allow only reversible work that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Continue the existing read-only evidence matrix and do not access credentials or private containers, alter permissions or configuration, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct outreach.

Security review of the candidate plan: retain containment-only execution. Do not dispatch or requeue security-sensitive or launch work until dated evidence covers access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Existing ordinary reversible work may continue only within current consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, and data boundaries.
